login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to see your trips.
login.failed: We could not sign you in. Check your e-mail and password.
login.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

trip.deleteMessage: “{title}” and everything planned in it — every destination, every day and every item — will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

trips.title: Trips
trips.emptyBody: Create your first trip and its empty timeline, then fill it in day by day.

tripCreate.title: New trip
tripCreate.subtitle: Set the dates, the route and the destinations. The days are filled in afterwards, item by item.
tripCreate.stagesHint: Add each base of the trip, in order. Dates are optional — leave them empty if you have not decided how to split the days yet.
tripCreate.summary: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} / {nights, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} · {stages, plural, one {# base} other {# bases}}
tripCreate.submit: Create an empty timeline to plan by hand

timeline.emptyTimeline: This timeline is empty. Open a day and add your first item.

day.title: Day
day.empty: Nothing planned for this day yet. Add the first item.

item.endDateHint: Only for something that runs past midnight — an overnight flight, or several nights in one place.

error.invalid_credentials: We could not sign you in. Check your e-mail and password.
error.not_authenticated: You need to sign in to see this.
error.csrf_token_invalid: Your session could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
error.validation_error: Some of the details are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
error.service_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
error.invalid_date_range: The end date cannot be before the start date.
error.trip_too_long: A trip can be at most 366 days long. Check the dates.
error.stages_required: Add at least one destination to the trip.
error.stage_outside_trip: A destination's dates fall outside the trip's dates.
error.invalid_time_span: That start and end do not describe a real stretch of time. Check the times and the end date.
error.date_outside_trip: That date is outside this trip.
error.days_have_items: Those days already have items on them. Move or delete the items first, then shorten the trip.
error.stages_outside_new_range: Some destinations fall outside the new dates. Adjust them first, then shorten the trip.
error.items_outside_new_range: Some items run past the new end date. Shorten or delete them first, then shorten the trip.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
